An '''unidentified [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' was a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had embraced anger and hatred, falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They wielded a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="CotF" />
